title: The Nymphs of Latex Lake (Standard)

And lastly I want you to move away from your keyboard, phone and close your eyes. The only sensory stimuli you should feel is that of my voice and my voice alone. If you are all set and ready, sit back, relax and enjoy!
author: Mistress Shibby
